newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares close dull session slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares close dull session slightly higher.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Swiss shares closed slightly higher in listless trade, yielding midday gains after early losses on Wall Street put pressure on the market.

A dealer said positive fundamentals such as low interest rates are being shrugged off. "People are afraid of a continued correction given the high level of the market, but liquidity remains high and there is no alternative to shares", he added, noting a year-end rally may set in in November.
* Blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) up 10.7 points, or 0.29 percent, to 3,753.6.
Volumes were described as below average. U.S. jobless data had little effect.
* Actively-traded Roche firmed 50 francs to 9,590. Sandoz was up 0.5 percent while Ciba registered shares were flat.
* Clariant jumped 1.36 percent. The stock profited from recent buy recommendations and is considered a good alternative to Roche, Ciba and Sandoz, a dealer said.
* Swiss Re saw lively interest after a recent weak streak. The shares rose 19 francs or 1.44 percent to 1,341.
* Second-tier Logitech soared five percent to 147 francs.
* Cyclicals Sulzer, Alusuisse and Holderbank posted bigger losses. ABB drew strength from a India order, adding five francs to 1,569.
* Swissair extended losses, dropping 3.6 percent to 963. The shares have shown some volatility in the past few days.
* Watchmaker Tag Heuer continued its recent slump, sliding 2.63 percent to 203.50.
